description: The ceiling of a horizontal hole: 90 degrees from vertical, held along both sides, a 4.8 mm bridge within the 12 mm maxUnsupportedBridgeMm: a warning, never a blocker (docs/plan/05 section 6).

findings.fix: nothing to change for most parts; for a cleaner underside, turn on the slicer's bridge detection (PrusaSlicer: detect bridging perimeters)
findings.message: 1 region of downward faces steeper than the 50° maxOverhangDeg of process `fdm-0.4` prints as a short bridge, the longest 4.8 mm, within the 12 mm maxUnsupportedBridgeMm: its underside may come out a little rough

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
